udfps_icon.why_not_observed: No fingerprint template is enrolled on this phone, so SystemUI draws no UDFPS affordance on the lock screen and there is nothing to measure. dumpsys fingerprint reports "count":0 and no Udfps window exists. The screenshot taken at the sensor location contains only ordinary lock-screen content; an early measurement of 73x86 px at (595,1976) was that content, not the icon.
udfps_icon.how_to_confirm: Enrol a fingerprint, lock the screen, then run reports/tier2-camera-20260909/measure_udfps_icon.py against a fresh screencap; the icon should measure about 132 px across inside the 148 px sensor square.
udfps_icon.note: Upstream fixes the icon at 6000 um (99 px). The overlay raises it to 8000 um, 132 px inside the 148 px sensor square. The built SystemUI carries 8000 where the previous build carried 6000; the drawn icon is unverified because no fingerprint is enrolled.
